project.name: Pilot program
project.summary: Onboard 3 researchers onto Engelbart, fix what breaks, and get them weekly active.
project.description:
Pilot users run Engelbart on their own machines with their real chats, papers and notes. We watch the first import live, then check in at weeks 1, 2 and 4.

**Converted pilot** (PIL-36): weekly active in 3 of the 4 weeks after onboarding (opened a note *and* followed at least one provenance link that week) and says yes to "would you pay $15/month" at the week-4 check-in.

Pilots: Priya Raman (UC Berkeley, 10/9), Daniel Osei (CMU, 10/13), pilot 3 TBD.

statusUpdates.body:
Both pilots onboarded.

* Priya re-import: Claude 612/612, 987 unique PDFs from 1,214 files (PIL-23).
* Daniel: blocked on Notion and Granola import (PIL-24, PIL-25) and confused by the connect screen's "Other" (PIL-26, Priya hit it too).
* "Converted pilot" is defined (PIL-36) and goes on the demo day slide.

**Risk:** pilot 3 isn't recruited (PIL-33), so *3 converted pilots* by 11/13 is at risk even if both current pilots convert.

## Pilot 1 done (Priya, 10/9)

* Import missed 141 of her 612 Claude conversations: everything inside Claude Projects plus untitled chats collapsing on the dedupe key. Root-caused, fix in review (PIL-14).
* Same PDFs twice from Zotero and Downloads (PIL-15). *Import dedupe rules v0* written; hash + DOI dedupe in progress.
* Best moment: the provenance trail. Moving it to step 1 of the tour (PIL-17).

Next: Daniel on Tuesday 10/13.
